name: carpal tunnel and ulnar wrist neuropathy overview
title: Numbness or tingling in the hand split by which fingers: the median side goes to carpal tunnel syndrome and the ulnar side to ulnar neuropathy at the wrist in Guyon's canal; each column gives the presentation, causes, the workup that rules out the nerve-root mimic with EMG and nerve conduction studies, and treatment in order

root.title: Numbness or tingling in the hand: WHICH FINGERS?
lines: both are entrapments AT THE WRIST, and each has a nerve-root mimic in the neck

groups.title: Thumb, index, middle + half the ring finger
Little finger + half the ring finger

head: h
Carpal tunnel syndrome (CTS)
median nerve squeezed in the carpal tunnel
the 'bread and butter' nerve diagnosis
clue: • worse with the wrist flexed or extended (driving, holding a phone)
Median function ABOVE the tunnel is normal
inv: the main mimic · also tendinopathy, thumb-base (carpometacarpal) arthritis
• how severe is the nerve damage?
tx: common · reversible if caught early · hand position
avoid aggravating positions and vibrating tools

head: h
Ulnar neuropathy at the wrist
ulnar nerve squeezed in Guyon's (ulnar) canal
inv: the main mimic · also the ulnar nerve at the ELBOW, tendinopathy
• how severe is the nerve damage?
tx: hand position and pressure · reversible if caught early
